Our Story

A Family Farm Built on Passion

Started by our father with nothing but dedication and a deep love for the land, Boke Farm has grown into a thriving operation. We raise healthy chickens, grow strong seedlings, and take pride in everything we produce.

🌱
Quality Seedlings

Every seedling is nurtured carefully in our nursery beds until it's ready to thrive on your farm.

🐓
Healthy Poultry

Our chickens are raised naturally — free-range and well-fed for the best meat and eggs.

🏅
Certified by FAO

Boke Farm is proudly certified by FAO, so you can buy with confidence.

🤝
Community First

We employ local workers and support our community with knowledge and fair prices.

Our Nursery

Seedlings for Every Farm & Garden

With over 100,000 seedlings grown, from fruit trees to vegetables, we raise robust, healthy plants ready for your land.

🥑

Avocado Seedlings

Grafted Hass and Fuerte varieties. High yield, pest-resistant, and adapted to Ugandan soils.

Fruit Tree
🍌

Banana Suckers

Matooke, Roho safi, and Cavendish for reliable harvests season after season.

Popular
☕

Coffee Seedlings

Robusta and Arabica varieties — Uganda's finest. Certified and disease-free from our nursery beds.

Export Grade
🌿

Vegetable Seedlings

Tomatoes, cabbages, onions, kale and more. Strong transplants ready for your garden or shamba.

Vegetables

Timber & Shade Trees

Eucalyptus, Musizi, and Gmelina for timber. Grown fast, sold affordable, planted with care.
